name: Idaho Summer Open 2018

venue.name: Americinn Lodge & Suites
venue.details: Second floor in the main conference room

information: Third year in a row, Rexburg is holding another competition. This competition is designed to help people qualify for the CubingUSA Nationals. We are trying to get as many events as possible, however in doing that we have to limit the amount of competitors to 45. Entry fees are at $18 per competitor, and free for spectators. We do ask you to limit the number of spectators due to the size of the room.
